source.available: For finite abelian L/K, local reciprocity identifies K*/N(L*) with Gal(L/K), and sends local units into inertia. This follows from the finite-quotient isomorphism in the proof of1.3 applied to the local class formation1.6(b).

needed: For the actual quadratic field Q(sqrt(h_star)), h_star=-m an odd fundamental discriminant, the local character at p|m restricts on Z_p* to the Legendre symbol. At all other finite places it is unramified and trivial on order-unit norms.
argument: At an odd p|m, v_p(h_star)=1. Set pi=sqrt(h_star). Its polynomial is Eisenstein and the quadratic extension is tamely totally ramified with O_L=Z_p[pi]. A unit of O_L is a+b*pi with a a unit, so its norm reduces modulo p to a². If a field element has unit norm, its L valuation is0 (residue degree1), so the same conclusion applies.

Conversely, a unit u whose residue is square has a square root v in Z_p* by simple-root Hensel, since p is odd. Viewed in L, N(v)=v²=u. Therefore the norms among base units are exactly those with square residue. The unique nontrivial quadratic reciprocity character is consequently (u/p).

Because h_star is the actual odd fundamental discriminant, the associated quadratic extension is unramified at finite p not dividingm, including2. The unit/inertia diagram then makes the associated character trivial on base units at those places. Norms of units of any local order R_p are base units. At split quaternion places the reduced norm is the determinant.

The preceding nilpotent weight transforms by Legendre(det u) at p|m; all other conjugation weights are invariant under order units. Multiplication therefore gives exactly chi_hstar(Nrd u)^(-1), with inverse immaterial for a quadratic character. This is the conjugation formula only; scaling parity/global root number are separate.
normalizations: Reciprocity inversion does not affect an order-two character. Uses actual quadratic Galois character restricted locally; no arbitrary finite character substituted.
limits: p|m is odd and has discriminant valuation1. No dyadic ramified norm computation is claimed.
Actual h_star/discriminant and local nilpotent weights are premises.
Global Atkin product sign and the twist formula remain separately supplied.
